show-invoice.description: Show that invoice in full next to the list, so the user can check what was charged.

dispute-charge.description: The user disputes a charge on that invoice. Keep the invoice, and offer a person to talk to and their open tickets.

confirm-return.description: The host has started the return. Replace the form with the order's tracker and confirm it in a note.

confirm-callback.description: The host has booked a callback. Confirm it in one note and keep the rest of the page.
